title: group.json
description: Marks a git repository as a review group. Written once when the group is created. Readers ignore unknown properties.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this format. A reader that does not know the version refuses the group and says so.

id.description: Opaque identifier. Never the only handle a tool keeps for a group: it can change when two groups are joined.

name.description: Display name. Optional: tools fall back to the folder name.
